mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ROOM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM ( CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, ROOM_NAME, ROOM_TYPE, MATCHING_SEQ, CREATED_BY, ROOM_STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{chat_room_seq}, #{room_name}, #{room_type}, #{matching_seq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{created_by}, #{room_status}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_CHAT_PARTICIPANT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_PARTICIPANT ( CHAT_PARTICIPANT_SEQ, CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PARTICIPANT_ROLE, PARTICIPANT_STATUS, JOINED_AT ) VALUES ( #{chat_participant_seq}, #{chat_room_seq}, #{member_seq}, #{participant_role}, #{participant_status}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ROOM_LIST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM_LIST ( CHAT_ROOM_LIST_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, STATUS, LAST_READ_MESSAGE_SEQ, DELETED_MESSAGE_SEQ, LEFT_AT, DELETED_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{chat_room_list_seq}, #{member_seq}, #{chat_room_seq}, #{status}, #{last_read_message_seq}, #{deleted_message_seq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NULL, NULL, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT CRL.CHAT_ROOM_LIST_SEQ, CRL.MEMBER_SEQ, CRL.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, CRL.STATUS, CRL.LAST_READ_MESSAGE_SEQ, CRL.DELETED_MESSAGE_SEQ, CRL.LEFT_AT, CRL.DELETED_AT, CRL.CREATED_AT, CR.ROOM_NAME, CR.ROOM_TYPE, (SELECT MAX(CP2.MEMBER_SEQ) FROM CHAT_PARTICIPANT CP2 WHERE CP2.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CR.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AND CP2.MEMBER_SEQ <> CRL.MEMBER_SEQ AND CP2.PARTICIPANT_STATUS = 'JOINED') AS PARTNER_SEQ, (SELECT MAX(MP.NICKNAME) FROM CHAT_PARTICIPANT CP2 JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE MP ON MP.MEMBER_SEQ = CP2.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE CP2.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CR.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AND CP2.MEMBER_SEQ <> CRL.MEMBER_SEQ AND CP2.PARTICIPANT_STATUS = 'JOINED') AS PARTNER_NICK, (SELECT CM.MESSAGE_CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM WHERE CM.CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ = ( SELECT MAX(CM2.CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM2 WHERE CM2.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CR.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AND CM2.DELETED_YN = 'N' )) AS LAST_MESSAGE, (SELECT MAX(CM3.CREATED_AT) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM3 WHERE CM3.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CR.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AND CM3.DELETED_YN = 'N') AS LAST_SEND_TIME, 0 AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM_LIST CRL JOIN CHAT_ROOM CR ON CR.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CRL.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ WHERE CRL.MEMBER_SEQ = #{value} AND CRL.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND CRL.LEFT_AT IS NULL AND CRL.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND CR.ROOM_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY NVL( (SELECT MAX(CM4.CREATED_AT) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM4 WHERE CM4.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CR.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ), CR.CREATED_AT ) DESC
SELECT CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, ROOM_NAME, ROOM_TYPE, MATCHING_SEQ, CREATED_BY, ROOM_STATUS, CREATED_AT, CLOSED_AT FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{value}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CHAT_MESSAGE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE ( CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ, CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, SENDER_SEQ, MESSAGE_TYPE, SYSTEM_EVENT_TYPE, MESSAGE_CONTENT, CREATED_AT, DELETED_YN ) VALUES ( #{chat_message_seq}, #{chat_room_seq}, #{sender_seq}, #{message_type}, #{system_event_type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{message_content}, SYSDATE, 'N' )

SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ATTACHMENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_ATTACHMENT ( CHAT_ATTACHMENT_SEQ, CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_URL, FILE_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, DURATION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{chat_attachment_seq}, #{chat_message_seq}, #{original_name}, #{stored_name}, #{file_url}, #{file_type}, #{file_size}, #{duration}, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_CHAT_MESSAGE_READ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE_READ ( CHAT_MESSAGE_READ_SEQ, CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ ) VALUES ( #{chat_message_read_seq}, #{chat_message_seq}, #{member_seq} )
mapper.select: SELECT CM.CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ, CM.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, CM.SENDER_SEQ, CM.MESSAGE_TYPE, CM.SYSTEM_EVENT_TYPE, CM.MESSAGE_CONTENT, CM.CREATED_AT, CM.DELETED_YN FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM WHERE CM.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{value} AND CM.DELETED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CM.CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ ASC

SELECT CM.CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ, CM.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, CM.SENDER_SEQ, CM.MESSAGE_TYPE, CM.SYSTEM_EVENT_TYPE, CM.MESSAGE_CONTENT, CM.CREATED_AT, CM.DELETED_YN FROM CHAT_MESSAGE CM WHERE CM.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{roomSeq} AND CM.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_PARTICIPANT CP JOIN CHAT_ROOM_LIST CRL ON CRL.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CP.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AND CRL.MEMBER_SEQ = CP.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE CP.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CM.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AND CP.MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND CP.PARTICIPANT_STATUS = 'JOINED' AND CRL.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND CRL.LEFT_AT IS NULL AND CRL.DELETED_AT IS NULL ) ORDER BY CM.CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ ASC

SELECT CA.CHAT_ATTACHMENT_SEQ, CA.CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ, CA.ORIGINAL_NAME, CA.STORED_NAME, CA.FILE_URL, CA.FILE_TYPE, CA.FILE_SIZE, CA.DURATION, CA.CREATED_AT FROM CHAT_ATTACHMENT CA JOIN CHAT_MESSAGE CM ON CM.CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ = CA.CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ WHERE CM.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{value} AND CM.DELETED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CA.CHAT_ATTACHMENT_SEQ ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_PARTICIPANT CP JOIN CHAT_ROOM_LIST CRL ON CRL.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CP.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ AND CRL.MEMBER_SEQ = CP.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE CP.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{roomSeq} AND CP.MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND CP.PARTICIPANT_STATUS = 'JOINED' AND CRL.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND CRL.LEFT_AT IS NULL AND CRL.DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT M.MEMBER_SEQ, M.LOGIN_ID, NVL( (SELECT MAX(MP.NICKNAME) FROM MEMBER_PROFILE MP WHERE MP.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ), M.NICKNAME ) AS NICKNAME, CP.PARTICIPANT_ROLE, (SELECT PI.FILE_URL FROM PROFILE_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ AND PI.PROFILE_IMAGE_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(PI2.PROFILE_IMAGE_SEQ) FROM PROFILE_IMAGE PI2 WHERE PI2.MEMBER_SEQ = M.MEMBER_SEQ)) AS PROFILE_IMAGE FROM CHAT_PARTICIPANT CP JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_SEQ = CP.MEMBER_SEQ WHERE CP.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{value} AND CP.PARTICIPANT_STATUS = 'JOINED' ORDER BY CASE WHEN CP.PARTICIPANT_ROLE = 'OWNER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CP.JOINED_AT
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CHAT_INVITATION.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_INVITATION ( CHAT_INVITATION_SEQ, CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, INVITER_SEQ, INVITEE_SEQ, INVITATION_STATUS, INVITED_AT, RESPONDED_AT ) VALUES ( #{chat_invitation_seq}, #{chat_room_seq}, #{inviter_seq}, #{invitee_seq}, #{invitation_status}, SYSDATE, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT CI.CHAT_INVITATION_SEQ, CI.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, CI.INVITER_SEQ, CI.INVITEE_SEQ, CI.INVITATION_STATUS, CI.INVITED_AT, CI.RESPONDED_AT, CR.ROOM_NAME, MP.NICKNAME AS INVITER_NICK FROM CHAT_INVITATION CI JOIN CHAT_ROOM CR ON CR.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = CI.CHAT_ROOM_SEQ JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE MP ON MP.MEMBER_SEQ = CI.INVITER_SEQ WHERE CI.INVITEE_SEQ = #{value} AND CI.INVITATION_STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CI.INVITED_AT DESC
SELECT CHAT_INVITATION_SEQ, CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, INVITER_SEQ, INVITEE_SEQ, INVITATION_STATUS, INVITED_AT, RESPONDED_AT FROM CHAT_INVITATION WHERE CHAT_INVITATION_SEQ = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_INVITATION SET INVITATION_STATUS = #{status}, RESPONDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CHAT_INVITATION_SEQ = #{invitationSeq} AND INVITATION_STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_PARTICIPANT WHERE CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{roomSeq} AND MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM_LIST WHERE CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{roomSeq} AND MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_INVITATION SET INVITATION_STATUS = 'REJECTED', RESPONDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{value} AND INVITATION_STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE CHAT_PARTICIPANT SET PARTICIPANT_STATUS = 'LEFT', LEFT_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{value} AND PARTICIPANT_STATUS = 'JOINED'
UPDATE CHAT_ROOM_LIST SET STATUS = 'LEFT', LEFT_AT = SYSDATE, DELETED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{value} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE CHAT_ROOM SET ROOM_STATUS = 'N', CLOSED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{value} AND ROOM_STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_PARTICIPANT WHERE CHAT_ROOM_SEQ = #{value} AND PARTICIPANT_STATUS = 'JOINED'
SELECT CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ, CHAT_ROOM_SEQ, SENDER_SEQ, MESSAGE_TYPE, SYSTEM_EVENT_TYPE, MESSAGE_CONTENT, CREATED_AT, DELETED_YN FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE CHAT_MESSAGE_SEQ = #{value}
